title: dot ai inventory v1 (one machine's agents and their drift)
description: Printed by `dot ai inventory show --json`: each installed agent's version, pin, sign-in and hook state, the AI policy's digest, and the drift among them. dot doctor and `dot fleet drift agents` read it. Never a credential: sign-in is only where one was found.

path.description: Where the AI policy is read from (DOT_AI_POLICY, else ~/.config/dotfiles/ai-policy.toml)

sha256.description: The policy file's SHA-256; null when there is no policy

agents.description: The roster's agents found on PATH, in roster order

version.description: The first dotted number of `<bin> --version`; null when there is none

pin.description: Its version in [ai_tools]; null for a native install, which has no pin

auth.description: key: an API key in the environment; login: a credentials file or keychain item; unknown: dot does not know where this agent keeps it

hooks.description: dot cli hook wired into the agent's configuration; n/a for an agent dot does not hook or one never configured; unknown when its configuration cannot be read

drift.description: One entry per finding, in agent order

kind.description: version: off its pin; hooks: dot's hooks missing
